sections.title: Common colour idioms
sections.content:
English has many idioms using colours:
• in the red — in debt. The company has been in the red for three years.
• out of the blue — unexpectedly. She called me out of the blue after ten years.
• green with envy — very jealous. He was green with envy when he saw her new car.
• see red — become very angry. I saw red when I discovered they had lied.
• grey area — an unclear or undefined topic. The legal rules on this issue remain a grey area.

sections.title: More colour expressions
sections.content:
Additional idioms and expressions with colours:
• white lie — a harmless lie told to be polite. I told a white lie to spare her feelings.
• black market — illegal trade. Luxury goods are often sold on the black market.
• golden opportunity — an excellent chance. This internship is a golden opportunity for your career.
• paint the town red — go out and celebrate wildly. It's her birthday — let's paint the town red!
• once in a blue moon — very rarely. I only eat fast food once in a blue moon.

exercises.question: When something happens unexpectedly, it comes out of the:
exercises.explanation: Out of the blue means without warning; unexpectedly.

exercises.question: A company losing money is 'in the ___':
exercises.explanation: In the red means in debt or operating at a loss.

exercises.question: A small, harmless lie told to be polite is a ___ lie:
exercises.explanation: A white lie is a harmless or trivial lie told to avoid hurting someone's feelings.

exercises.question: An unclear topic with no definite rules is a ___ area:
exercises.explanation: A grey area is a situation that is not clear or well-defined.

exercises.question: Being extremely jealous is being green with:
Something that happens very rarely happens once in a blue:
exercises.explanation: Once in a blue moon means very rarely.

exercises.question: An excellent chance that shouldn't be missed is a ___ opportunity:
exercises.explanation: A golden opportunity is a very favourable chance.

exercises.question: Illegal buying and selling is the ___ market:
exercises.explanation: The black market is illegal trade in goods.
